title: Nubank Introduces New Croma Segment with Platinum Card and Benefits
description: Nubank has announced the launch of a new segment called Nubank Croma, targeting medium-income customers with a Platinum card and various benefits.

sections.heading: Nubank Croma Introduction
paragraphs: Nubank, a leading financial technology company in Brazil, has announced the launch of a new segment named Nubank Croma, designed for medium-income customers, according to the company's official announcement.

sections.heading: Features of Nubank Croma
paragraphs: The Nubank Croma segment offers a Platinum card with a cashback of 0.8% on all purchases and 5% on streaming subscriptions. Additionally, it includes a Caixinha Turbo with an interest rate of 120% and a special NuCel plan, as detailed by Nubank.
list: Platinum card with 0.8% cashback on all purchases

sections.heading: Target Audience
paragraphs: Nubank Croma is aimed at customers who consolidate their finances with the bank, as reported by Valor Econômico, and is positioned as a segment for medium-income individuals, according to the same source.

faq.a: Nubank Croma is a new segment launched by Nubank, offering a Platinum card and various benefits targeting medium-income customers.

faq.q: What benefits does Nubank Croma offer?
faq.a: Nubank Croma offers a Platinum card with 0.8% cashback on all purchases, 5% on streaming subscriptions, a Caixinha Turbo with 120% interest rate, and a special NuCel plan.
